tasks.description: Read docs/plans/workflow-completion-recovery-tasks.md#shared-worker-and-reviewer-context and the referenced TinySpec acceptance below in full; carry its binding constraints and this task's REQUIRED observables into worker/reviewer briefs. Worker finishes assigned implementation and worker-owned checks/evidence, reports real blockers and returns; runner owns configured checks/reruns, focused commit and fresh independent review. Pending runner stages alone do not require unsuccessful status. A reasoned correction awaiting a promised runner rerun is supported, never a waived rerun. Keep the common explicit unsuccessful boundary unchanged: no prose inference, coercion to success, extra judge call or worker Git commit. Extend existing Engine, authority, check-correction and host fixtures; update current operating/schema descriptions with the ownership distinction. Exclude diagnostics transport, review attribution and recovery selection.
